manifest_row.title: Research reveals evidence of climate change in the Yukon permafrost

screening.main_topic: A study reconstructing Holocene summer temperatures in the Yukon and finding that recent warming is unprecedented in that record, with implications for permafrost thaw and greenhouse-gas release.
